text: Viewed as kernel machines, NVAR performs EXACT regression with a ___ kernel, whereas an ESN performs approximate regression with an implicit random-feature kernel.
explanation: NVAR's explicit monomial feature map corresponds exactly to the degree-d polynomial kernel (c + φ·φ')^d — a finite, exact Mercer expansion. The ESN instead uses random projections that only approximate a smooth (RBF-like) shift-invariant kernel, with error O(N^{-1/2}) by the Rahimi–Recht theorem. Exact-polynomial vs approximate-random is the core distinction between the two methods.
